name: Sacri Monti of Piedmont and Lombardy
description: Nine hillside pilgrimage complexes scattered across Piedmont and Lombardy in northern Italy, the Sacri Monti were built in the late 1500s and 1600s. Visitors climb winding paths past chapels filled with life-sized painted statues and frescoes that stage scenes from the Christian story. Set among woods, hills and lakes, each one blends devotion, art and landscape.
